name: Pensacola Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Pensacola Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes; plain golf carts only on designated roads. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less in Pensacola Beach; on Pensacola Beach that includes Via de Luna and Fort Pickens Road, but not the bridges.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts only on roads a city or county has designated and signed for carts
Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; cross faster roads only at intersections
No golf carts or LSVs on the Bob Sikes Bridge
Golf carts on designated county roads only, not the Navarre Bridge
rules.citation: Santa Rosa County golf cart ordinance

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Via de Luna?
faq.a: Yes. Via de Luna is posted 35 mph or less, so registered LSVs may use it.

faq.q: Can I take a golf cart over the bridge to Pensacola?
faq.a: No. Golf carts and LSVs can't use the Bob Sikes Bridge.
